question_text: A Python class names an internal helper _add_booking. Describe what the single underscore communicates and whether it prevents outside calls.
adaptation_rationale: Replaces Java protected semantics with accurate Python naming convention; does not claim enforced privacy.
solution: It signals a non-public implementation convention. Python does not enforce a protected access boundary merely from this underscore; outside code can still call the method.
